title: The cut-open torus walk: its symmetries, the torus it comes from, and what is special at powers of two
claim: For the walk A of the n x n torus of rule-60 rings cut open both ways (the alternating medial digraph of the n x n grid with the outer face's arcs removed, over GF(2)), in doubled coordinates: (1) A + A^T = T (x) T on the contacts, T the null-boundary path walk on 2n - 1 sites; (2) the quarter turn commutes with A and the mirror and diagonal reflections carry A to A^T, so reach is symmetric under them; (3) A is the principal submatrix of the uncut torus walk M on all contacts but the two cut lines, so (I - wA)^-1 = R_UU - R_UC R_CC^-1 R_CU with R = (I - wM)^-1 and det(I - wA) = det(I - wM) det R_CC(w); (4) at n = 2^m, M^n = 0, the blocks of R on the cut lines are circle Green's functions, and det(I - wA) = det R_CC(w), a 2n x 2n polynomial determinant; (5) for every n, det(xI - A^2 on h) = det(u_n(y) + u_(n-1)(y) L + R u_(n-1)(y) + R u_(n-2)(y) L) with y = xI + T_(n-1); (6) if the minimal polynomial of A^4 on a layer is irreducible of full degree, every contact reads every contact, which holds at sides 3, 5, 7, 11 and at no other side from 3 to 24. Computed exactly: among sides 3 to 64 every eigenvalue of A is a (2n - 1)-th root of unity exactly at 4, 8, 16, 32 and 64 (A^(e(2n - 1)) = I with e = 4, 8, 16, 16, 32); there every eigenvalue of A^4 on a layer has multiplicity k(k + 1)/2 and geometric multiplicity 2k - 1. The theorem that full reach fails exactly at the powers of two from 8 is not proved.
failure_conditions: A side at which A + A^T differs from T (x) T, the quarter turn fails to commute with A, or a reflection fails to carry A to A^T.
A side at which A is not the principal submatrix of the torus walk off the cut lines.
A power of two n at which M^n != 0, a cut-line block of R differs from the circle's Green's function, or det(I - wA) != det R_CC(w).
A side at which the transfer identity fails.
A side from 3 to 64 other than a power of two at which every eigenvalue is a (2n - 1)-th root of unity, or a power of two to 64 at which one is not.
foundation_claim_scope: The square torus of rule-60 rings with equally spaced law-(12, 12) contacts, cut open by a ring of cuts each way (A30, A32, A37, A38); its walk over GF(2). Theorems 1 to 5 are proved; the collapse and the multiplicities are computed; the full-reach theorem is open.
